description: React front-end component implementing a notes app that interacts with a backend API for CRUD operations on notes. Manages note list, editing, loading states, and user interactions.

methods.name: formatTimestamp(ts)
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string into a locale-specific date/time string, with error handling.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the backend API and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: onNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note by posting to the backend and updates the notes list.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves changes to the current note by PUT request to the backend and updates the notes list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the selected note after user confirmation and updates the notes list.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note, with unsaved changes warning.
